svg.text: Azure messaging: start with what you are sending

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Microsoft Learn draws the line between messages, discrete events and event series. The service mostly follows from that.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: After it sends, what does the producer expect?

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: This is the question that decides it. Not the stack, not the volume.
